scope: ROS node freshness and output validity only; detector package/config and acceptance limits unchanged

clocks.live: System UTC minus PointCloud2 acquisition header stamp; a valid positive acquisition timestamp is required. DDS metadata is not required in live mode.
clocks.replay: Explicit operator choice. System UTC minus DDS publisher source_timestamp; original header is a recording coordinate, acquisition age is null. Zero/missing/invalid publisher metadata never permits GO.
clocks.mode_selection: Never inferred from old or synthetic stamps. Bag validation and jury commands must select replay explicitly.
clocks.capability_diagnosis: Before registration: installed Humble executor discards MessageInfo; take_message returns source_timestamp/received_timestamp. Stock rmw_fastrtps_cpp offline probe delivered 3 samples with positive source timestamps between publisher before/after UTC timestamps (validation/quality_cycle/freshness/metadata_capability.json).
clocks.adapter: Own Humble SingleThreadedExecutor subclass forwards original take_message metadata for marked LiDAR subscriptions only; all other callbacks delegate to upstream executor. Queue draining keeps the same metadata. No global monkeypatch.

validity.age: Source age must be at most 0.5 s and not more than 0.05 s in the future; Python queue residence must be at most 0.5 s. Missing/non-finite/invalid clock values fail closed.
validity.queue: Queue lag is newest same-input increasing recording header minus processed header. Catch-up frames cannot permit GO; queue lag above 0.5 s is stale and FAULT takes priority over catch-up CAUTION.
validity.epoch: First frame of startup, topic/frame switch, header discontinuity, clock discontinuity, or resume after silence is invalid until a subsequent progressing frame. Backward/repeated stamps are invalid; large forward gaps reset epoch. Recovery requires valid clock and progression.
priority: FAULT for invalid/unknown/stale clock or core error
validity.clear_distance: Exposed clear_distance is zero whenever monitoring validity is false; raw detector estimate retained as detector_clear_distance. Health JSON/topics and RViz agree with validity/decision.
validity.stop_preservation: A detected STOP remains through watchdog, errors and invalid subsequent frames until a fresh valid non-STOP result clears it; held STOP is explicitly marked and never grants valid monitoring.
validity.watchdog: Silence invalidates monitoring and publishes a complete snapshot. Retained STOP wins over FAULT. snapshot_kind distinguishes watchdog/processing_error from frame results; checker excludes all non-frame snapshots.

unit_cases: metadata first sample and drained samples
acceptance.runtime: Real Humble stock Fast DDS replay with source metadata, freshness fields, no GO during invalid/catch-up state; existing original obstacle and clear replay acceptance retains p95 <=100 ms and zero post-settle unprocessed messages.
acceptance.no_retry_to_green: Report failures and corrections with provenance; no silent threshold changes or discarded failed trials.
acceptance.publication: Release hold remains; no tag or public release.
